text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"\"Driverless cars are a touchy subject\" and \"People need to know all the facts\"","quality":"clear framing","description":"The essay sets up the issue and signals a reasoned argument from the start instead of jumping straight into opinion."},{"evidence":"mentions distracted drivers, texting and driving, and the cars not being truly driverless","quality":"relevant support","description":"The essay backs its position with several concrete details and examples that connect directly to the article and its claim."},{"evidence":"\"This is where the convience of driverless cars can be very attractive\" followed by safety concerns","quality":"balanced reasoning","description":"The essay acknowledges benefits before turning to drawbacks, which makes the argument feel more thoughtful and credible."},{"evidence":"\"For example, if I'm eating a burger and fries while watching a movie...\"","quality":"specific elaboration","description":"The essay develops ideas with a vivid scenario that shows how the risk would play out in practice."},{"evidence":"\"Honestly, I really like this idea... but I'm just not ready to put my life or the life of my family at risk\"","quality":"conclusion with stance","description":"The essay ends by restating the position and summarizing the main reason for it in a clear closing statement."}]}
